a.text: Rudra joined the first batch of the Kings Commissioned Indian Officers (KCIOs) at the Daly College in Indore.

b.text: Rudra was commissioned into the 28th Punjabis as a temporary second lieutenant in the British Indian Army.

a.text: Rudra was promoted to acting lieutenant-colonel.

b.text: Lieutenant Colonel Rudra was transferred to the General Staff at GHQ India by General Claude Auchinleck.
